purpose: Version 3 of scenarios-corpus-1.json (28.09.2026): version 2 (run twice, kept unchanged) with a stricter check where Codex showed a false pass: for 31.10.2026 the uncertainty must be about that day, and no fee may be given for it. The date checks judge each act by its own title (lib/rag-v2/pilot/conversation-eval.js). The same 16 conversations and 40 turns. Each expectation names what it checks: 'evidence' is search (the source was found), 'cited', 'must', 'must_not', 'valid_on' and 'clarification' are the answer, 'region', 'service_summary', 'details', 'contacts', 'crisis' and 'previous_state_cleared' are the conversation state and the municipal catalogue. The first six scenarios are scenarios-1.json unchanged.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn (records.scope.region), or null
expectation_help.service_summary / details: a regular expression on a service title the catalogue summarised / gave in detail
expectation_help.contacts: a contact person of the focused service is in the evidence
expectation_help.crisis: the crisis notice is shown (true) or not (false)
expectation_help.previous_state_cleared: a new person starts without the previous person's circumstances
expectation_help.clarification: true: the answer asks for a missing circumstance; false: it must not; omitted: either is fine
expectation_help.evidence: each regular expression matches the title of a source the search gave the model
expectation_help.cited: each regular expression matches the title of a source the answer cites
expectation_help.must / must_not: regular expressions on the visible answer text
expectation_help.found_valid_on: search: each expected act (by the evidence patterns, else the cited ones, else every found act) has a found version in force on this date ('today' is the day of the run); a title alone does not tell the versions of one act apart, and another act does not stand in for it
expectation_help.valid_on: answer: every cited national act has a cited version in force on this date (today's version of the same act may be cited beside it to compare)
